title: TAI owner canonical images command
objective: Keep canonical image publication manual owner-command only. The owner may dispatch the existing all-service canonical Docker image workflow for unchanged current main, after which the already-merged protected REG.RU preflight, activation, acceptance, deployment and strict postflight chain remains authoritative.
boundaries: Canonical image publication is manual owner command only; no schedule or background automation is permitted
The only interactive command is /tai images current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must all equal the repository owner
The command resolves and revalidates unchanged origin/main before dispatch
Only the existing Build & Publish Canonical Docker Images workflow is dispatched with ref main and services all
A successful TAI REG.RU Deployment or recent pending canonical-image status prevents duplicate manual dispatch
The bridge has no Docker, SSH, sudo, production filesystem, database or application mutation authority
Production mutation remains NONE until the downstream protected REG.RU controller accepts preflight evidence
The existing protected preflight, restricted activation, live acceptance, rollback, deployment and strict postflight workflows remain the sole release authority
Every accepted manual dispatch publishes the exact target SHA and a pending canonical-image status
